sentence: POST /api/waterings with bed_id set to JSON true returns 201 and records the watering on bed 1 instead of a 422.
evidence: Signed in via POST /api/auth/login with the demo credentials, then POST /api/waterings with body {"bed_id":true}. Got HTTP 201 and {"id":3,"bed_id":1,"bed_name":"North bed","watered_on":"2026-11-12","watered_at":"2026-11-12 18:53:25","litres":null}, so a watering was saved on bed 1. For comparison, {"bed_id":"abc"} returns 422 int_parsing. The cause is that WateringIn.bed_id is declared as `int = Field(gt=0)` under pydantic's lax mode with no strict setting, so JSON true is turned into 1. I deleted the test watering afterwards (DELETE returned 204).
